data.migratedNodes: number — count of distinct nodeIds with at least one node-tagged, non-archived observation
data.migratedObservations: number — total observation texts that would be (or were) folded into a playbook add-delta
data.skippedWithoutNodeId: number — observations with no nodeId (top-level or in metadata), which this migration cannot attribute to any node
data.dryRun: boolean — echoes the request; true means nothing was written

calls.notes: The prior workbench code read a nonexistent `res.migrated` field from this verb's response; the real fields are migratedNodes/migratedObservations/skippedWithoutNodeId/dryRun, all always present.

dryRun is optional; omitting it runs the migration for real (dryRun defaults falsy in the zod schema, matching Observations.tsx's global 'migrate all node-tagged observations' button, which sends no args).
